name: Katsuura (Chiba, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Katsuura city emblem in white: a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised letter V.
history: Municipal flag of Katsuura, a city in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 6 May 1957.

features.role: Katsuura city emblem — a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised letter V
